goal: Host xem thử đúng snapshot kỳ thi trên PTE App không đổi trạng thái, không lockdown, không lưu bài làm/upload/chấm điểm; nhận thông báo chuông khi đề sẵn sàng.

global_context.framework: Java 21/Spring modular monolith; Flutter/Material 3/BLoC; Next.js tenant-web
global_context.architecture: Read-only host preview with shared renderers and isolated local response state
constraints: Planning only; no implementation or discard executed yet.
Quang authorizes discarding only the reviewed temporary global security flag changes before coding, after backup and fresh diff verification.
HOST_ADMIN only, server-enforced tenant ownership; no pre-login toggle; no STUDENT access to host preview.
Host+student account defaults to explicit host preview; student attempts never inherit preview privileges.
Snapshot required; no generate/start/open/state change while viewing.
Answers RAM only; recording temp local only, cleaned on next/exit and crash recovery; no response cache/DB/outbox/upload/grading/quota.
Next on every preview task; preserve student behavior and real-test layout.
Reuse common inbox, auth and renderer infrastructure; no external paid integration, no deep-link setup required.
Existing exam media downloads still incur normal requests/bandwidth; do not promise zero third-party usage.
Follow AGENTS and applicable standards before code; preserve unrelated worktree changes.
New output paths proposed; implementation preflight must refine exact file inventory and conditional Flyway/client enum files.
Read quang-agent-handoff.md and quang-acceptance-matrix.md before execution; refined source facts override earlier report shorthand.
Recipient is generating actor HOST_ADMIN, not a nonexistent creator field; new notification CHECK migration required.
SnapshotContentResponse lacks timing; use shared public resolver preserving current student timing parity, no attempt.internal imports.
Refine exact output inventory including migration path in quang-execution-file-manifest.md before phase writes.
